storage.description: Each named scenario merges the disjoint fields at its $common_fields_ref with its own fields. Recursively replace sole-key {$ref: pointer} objects with the pointed value. All pointers are local; list order, numeric values, null actuals and every decision are preserved. Sources and selected doses remain full resolved values, never abbreviated summaries.
storage.mutation_rule: Resolver returns independent scenario copies; do not edit raw pooled values to change an individual scenario.

common_fields.dose_status: Reference packets are upper clock envelopes. Select knee/hip caps and support level from dose_options using actual recent history; no reference overrides a smaller actual record.
common_fields.history_selection_rule: Use actual most recent compatible knee/hip count; unknown unloaded instruction selects two reps. Familiar DB needs the most recent actual compatible loaded record and independently familiar10s handling; more recent unloading is not restored. Low supports or a recorded smaller reduction preserve actual recent work.

v6.variant: Basic alternating march in place — explicit stationary teaching adaptation
v6.effort_load: Bodyweight, easy2/10. Two seconds per comfortable walking-height step; four alternating steps, two each side, then settle2s. Use relaxed opposite arm/leg timing without a forced thigh-height target.
v6.notes: One foot remains supported; no flight or forward travel. Each left/right step is one count, not a two-step cycle. This is the same basic pattern used in the instructional preparation; it is not exact traveling A-March or sprint exposure.

v11.variant: Standing Static Short Start — low-intent teaching adaptation
v11.effort_load: Bodyweight; smooth easy intent rising from about2/10 toward3/10, then retain a relaxed comfortable rhythm. No maximal effort, measured speed quota or fly-zone result.
v11.notes: Each set is one whole counted attempt including any fault. Active/exit estimate15s; separate outside walking return20s. These are logistics estimates, not forced cadence. No corrective or assessment repetition is added. Exact steps/contacts and return metres remain actual observations.

v15.effort_load: Bodyweight, ordinary conversational walking about2/10. Recognize the assigned markers and exit; no jog, forced technical thigh height, abrupt terminal plant or timed redirect.
v15.notes: Each set is one whole counted attempt including any fault. Active/exit estimate45s; separate outside walking return40s. These are logistics estimates, not forced cadence. No corrective or assessment repetition is added. Exact steps/contacts and return metres remain actual observations.

v21.variant: Progressive Build and Upright Rhythm Run — modest nonmaximal intent context
v21.effort_load: Bodyweight. From still comfortable standing, build smoothly over0–10m from about2/10 toward4/10, then keep relaxed purposeful4/10 through10–20m. Slow gradually through20–35m. This is a provisional coaching effort cue, not a speed percentage, required pace or maximal/flying sprint.
v21.notes: Each set is one whole counted attempt including any fault. Active/exit estimate25s; separate outside walking return40s. These are logistics estimates, not forced cadence. No corrective or assessment repetition is added. Exact steps/contacts and return metres remain actual observations. Retain the actual smaller compatible opportunity count. All25s active phases are planning allowances, not segment targets; earlier clearance leaves quiet time. The full40s outside return includes turning/rejoining. Longer actual action/return delays later releases; omit uncompleted later work instead of forcing pace. Record actual effort, slowing and faults; no extra trial.
